title: Polish store badge geometry and regional news navigation
question: Can the existing homepage offer aligned crisp downloads and explicit regional news destinations?
hypotheses: Native badge proportions and bottom-aligned action areas remove the raster border mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Four apps retain six active store links and two noninteractive iOS Coming soon states.
Badge edges and actionable bounds coincide and download rows align at desktop/mobile sizes.
News links explicitly target /us/ and /tw/ in English and Traditional Chinese.
Local verification, independent review, merged release and public verification are recorded.
evidence: Owner requests fine alignment and separate US/Taiwan News links, continuing the approved homepage merge/deployment.
